answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A new agent locks 50 POA and builds a fingerprint over 20 epochs, starting with a lotus survey. Later work must vary: a sparrow count, then new partners; clones are frozen. A falcon job copied across fifty identities triggers a hold. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA plus 20 epochs of faked work each. An honest agent pays once, unlocks, and earns undiluted rewards.
